channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Eric Bledsoe | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Eric Bledsoe from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tyson Chandler on Eric Bledsoe, Brandon Knight, Devin Booker
item.description:
“He was like, ‘Really? What do you think about (Knight and Bledsoe)?' I was like, ‘They’re good, but I’m telling you, me, them, this roster, (Booker is) better than all of us. That’s the best player you got on this roster,’ and he was like ‘Really?’”

Tyson Chandler on Eric Bledsoe, Brandon Knight, Devin Booker, Sep 8, 2023. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Eric Bledsoe
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Bucks coach Mike Budenholzer on new Blazer Eric Bledsoe:

“Great guy. I love Bled. Really special human being. An incredible defender. An elite, elite-level defender. I think they’re getting a very good player. He’s one of my favorite people. I love him.”

Mike Budenholzer on Eric Bledsoe, Feb 5, 2022. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Eric Bledsoe
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Ty Lue on Bledsoe's reaction to coming off the bench:

“He was great, he's professional, he wants to win. Said, 'Whatever you want to do, Coach, I'm on board.'”

Tyronn Lue on Eric Bledsoe, Dec 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Josh Hart on Eric Bledsoe
item.description:
Christian Clark:Josh Hart on the criticism of Eric Bledsoe:

“All the critics can shut the fuck up. We believe in him. That's our guy.”

Josh Hart on Eric Bledsoe, Mar 31, 2021. Source: Twitter @cclark3000.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Eric Bledsoe
item.description:
Will Guillory:Stan Van Gundy on Eric Bledsoe:

“I don't think we've done a lot to help Eric right now.”

Stan Van Gundy on Eric Bledsoe, Dec 31, 2020. Source: Twitter @WillGuillory.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Steven Adams, Eric Bledsoe
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Stan Van Gundy on Adams/Bledsoe adding intensity:

“They're going to compete every single night. Our veteran guys are really highly competitive guys. You can put JJ in there (too). Those guys will get on the floor (for loose balls). Steven and Bled have brought that to our team.”

Stan Van Gundy on Steven Adams, Eric Bledsoe, Dec 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Eric Bledsoe
item.description:
Kane Pitman:Budenholzer on Bledsoe:

“He was such a good player for us and someone we all bonded with and have a close relationship with. It will be great to just see Bled and hopefully have a laugh or smile. He's certainly one of the best people I've ever been around.”

Mike Budenholzer on Eric Bledsoe, Dec 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @KanePitman.

item.title: Jon Horst on Eric Bledsoe
item.description:
Bucks general manager Jon Horst told Bleacher Report's Howard Beck.

“And I think it's evident, pretty strongly, in the fact that we extended Eric, what he means to us. The fact that we currently have the best record in the NBA, had the best record last year in the NBA, he's an All-NBA First Team defender and a guy that we feel strongly should be an All-Star for the Milwaukee Bucks this year. We have not had those conversations, and we are not going to trade Eric Bledsoe.”

Jon Horst on Eric Bledsoe, Jan 23, 2020. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Eric Bledsoe
item.description:
“It was. They should've overturned it. That's why I hate the rule. Nobody wants to be wrong. Let me just say that. You have to overturn that. Unless Bledsoe fouled Lou with his face, there was no foul on that play.”

Doc Rivers on Eric Bledsoe, Nov 7, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Terry Rozier on Eric Bledsoe
item.description:
Mark Murphy:Rozier on his playoff reunion with the Bucks' Eric Bledsoe:

“We get in-between them lines, we're two guys that want to win for our teams. It's going to be there - the bad blood is going to be there.”

Terry Rozier on Eric Bledsoe, Apr 26, 2019. Source: Twitter @Murf56.

item.title: Terry Rozier on Eric Bledsoe
item.description:
Terry Rozier on Eric Bledsoe:

“He can’t motivate me. He don’t motivate me at all. Even the negative stuff when you turn on ESPN, they wasn’t motivating me before the playoffs started. I already motivated myself so they were too late.”

Terry Rozier on Eric Bledsoe, Apr 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Rich Paul on Eric Bledsoe
item.description:
Rich Paul:

“Eric [Bledsoe] is happy, he's now in Milwaukee... I think they are like 14 and 7 since he got there, he's playing well, and that's all that matters to me.”

Rich Paul on Eric Bledsoe, Dec 26, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Eric Bledsoe, Reggie Jackson
item.description:
“I left practice yesterday and there’s a rumor out on Reggie and Bledsoe so I had to get home and call Reggie and say we’re not trading you for Bledsoe. I don’t usually address all of them but it’s early in the (season). You can’t address all of them at the trade deadline, but I felt the need to address this.”

Stan Van Gundy on Eric Bledsoe, Reggie Jackson, Nov 4, 2017. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Eric Bledsoe
item.description:
Barbara Barker:Hornacek on Eric Bledsoe whom he coached in Phoenix:

“Eric’s a great player. He’s had a lot of success last year, he had success with us.”

Jeff Hornacek on Eric Bledsoe, Oct 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @meanbarb.

item.title: Earl Watson on Eric Bledsoe
item.description:
“When I first got here and Eric Bledsoe was shooting, everyone was intimidated to even rebound for him because he was so hard on himself and vocally loud about it,”

Earl Watson on Eric Bledsoe, Oct 16, 2017. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Khris Middleton on Eric Bledsoe
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Middleton on Eric Bledsoe's RFA episode:

“That's a terrible situation. It worked out for him but it's something I'd rather not be in.”

Khris Middleton on Eric Bledsoe, May 2, 2015. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.

item.title: Ryan McDonough on Eric Bledsoe, Markieff Morris
item.description:
and ,of criticism that the Suns traded their best player, McDonough said,

“My response would be that Eric Bledsoe and Markieff Morris still are in Phoenix Suns uniforms.”

Ryan McDonough on Eric Bledsoe, Markieff Morris, Feb 20, 2015. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Eric Bledsoe, Alex Len
item.description:
Goran Dragic:

“Of course, we still have a lot of salary cap. Probably next year, we'll go for big names, one of the superstars. But I think we drafted well, especially Alex Len, the big guy from Ukraine. Then we brought in Eric Bledsoe from the Clippers. So I think we'll play together in the backcourt, me as a 2 or 1, him as a 1 or 2. That will be a good combo for us.”

Goran Dragic on Eric Bledsoe, Alex Len, Sep 22, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Gary Sacks on Eric Bledsoe, DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
“I haven't called anybody to say, 'Hey, we have Eric Bledsoe and would you like him?' Or, 'We have DeAndre Jordan or we have anybody and would you want them?' That's not where I am right now with this team,”

Gary Sacks on Eric Bledsoe, DeAndre Jordan, Feb 16, 2013. Source: Los Angeles Times.
